items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: My husband used to play with them too.

ctx.x: Joseph and them too, huh? Oh yeah. My husband used to play with them too. Kaja, who was a clarinet player. And, um, when my husband played with him, though, he had, uh, Leo, Leo Sanjay, his cousin. That was my husband's cousin. He played, um, uh, banjo in that thing.
Yeah. And that's with, uh, with which one of the Joseph's? The one got the barbershop, I think.
Your husband was playing bass. The other one was coming from away. He got killed. He was living
